state: Task I17 integrates the K27 object-store capability slice: catalogue delta, checker/emitter hooks, runtime slice, ordinary Can helper package plus typed example. K27's deliverable is service.ts (844 lines) with its service-check.ts (17 checks): class ObjectStoreService exposing sharedDigest/openPrefix/receipt/closePrefix/openSession/sessionTokenForTest/closeSession/put/settleWrite/pending/get/delete/compareBytes/list/sealCleanup (getters prefixCount/liveSessionCount stay unmerged, as in I13-16). Records: PrefixReceipt/SessionFacts/ObjectFacts/WriteFacts/PageFacts/PendingFacts/CleanupReceipt. Failures: ObjectStoreError carrying one of 20 closed codes (unknown-prefix/prefix-closed/capacity-exhausted/wrong-owner/closed-handle/keys-remain/pending-writes/scan-incomplete/session-live/unknown-session/forged-token/forged-continuation/stale-continuation/unknown-key/key-escapes-prefix/malformed-key/write-unknown/write-busy/write-settled/bad-page) on exactly one of engine/driver/store. Construction binds exact (owner, prefix) grant pairs, an unreadable foreign sharedKeys fixture map, and six limits (maxPrefixes/maxSessions/maxObjects/maxObjectBytes/maxPageSize/maxPendingWrites); the self-check pins grants owner-a/tenant-a/owned and owner-b/tenant-b/owned, a 3-key sharedBucket, and roomyLimits 4/8/32/1024/8/16. Sessions mint sess- hex tokens checked by lookup; continuations mint cont- hex edges that are opaque, single-use, and stale after any mutation; put/get move Uint8Array copies with digest-only facts; compareBytes predicates byte equality yet reports malformed-key rather than throwing raw. Lineage: I13 introduced package db:: and error db::db_fault{layer, code} for doubles observers; I13 through I16 kept owner-first verbs, row owner elision, NT-I admission tags, verbatim layer/code failures, and fact-plus-token wrappers; I15 established bytes::buffer and option::value<str> crossings and void results are routine (files::write_bytes). The live S3 client already occupies s3:: (16 verbs, s3:: errors), while K27 declares the observer shares nothing executable with adapter code. Ledger: K27 complete (its evidence status line is stale); I17 provisional until P14 with no execution credit.

i17_observer_package.instructions: The I17 card demands a complete ordinary Can helper package for this slice. Given the I13 lineage (a fresh db:: package plus db::db_fault for doubles observers) and the occupied s3:: live-client lane, which catalogue home gives the 14 K27 verbs the clearest contract? Prefer the placement a future mechanical edit is least likely to confuse with live-client behavior.

criteria.new_store_package: Mint package store:: and error store::store_fault{layer, code} for the 14 observer verbs (open_prefix, receipt, close_prefix, open_session, close_session, put, settle_write, pending, get, delete, compare_bytes, list, seal_cleanup, shared_digest) with owner-first signatures, void where the service is void, bytes::buffer payloads, and an option::value<str> continuation. Directly continues the I13 db:: lineage; doubles and live-client verbs never share a package.
criteria.new_objects_package: Mint package objects:: and error objects::object_fault{layer, code} for the same 14 owner-first verbs, wording the package around objects/keys/digests instead of the store implementation noun. Identical separation from s3:: as new_store_package; differs only in the vocabulary future Can authors memorize.
criteria.extend_s3_package: Add the 14 observer verbs to s3:: with a fresh s3::observer_fault{layer, code}, so one package covers objects end to end and no new package/error family is introduced. Observer verbs (seal_cleanup, settle_write, continuations) then live beside live verbs (presign, upload_finish) under one prefix, which K27's no-sharing scope discourages.

i17_session_token_shape.instructions: Rows need the pinned sess- token for every effectful K27 verb, but openSession withholds it and only the test-only sessionTokenForTest reveals it. Which acquisition shape best honors the I13-16 fact-plus-token wrapper lineage while respecting the test-only marking? Favor the shape that minimizes new stable surface without hiding behavior rows must understand.

criteria.compose_token_in_adapter: Adapter open_session performs openSession followed by sessionTokenForTest internally and yields a single wrapper record holding facts plus token, so the catalogue shows the same fact-plus-token shape as I13-16 and the test-only readout never becomes invocable Can surface. Rows learn one verb; the composition is documented adapter behavior.
criteria.expose_token_op: Catalogue gains an explicit token-readout verb mirroring sessionTokenForTest one-to-one (owner-first, returns str), preserving a strict single-service-call-per-op adapter and leaving the test-only nature visible in the surface itself. Rows learn two verbs and the readout stays separately testable.
